subject: Renewal + capacity add-on: request for split invoice, prepay and billing contact update
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acme-dataworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity add-on: request for split invoice, prepay and billing contact update

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, Acme is moving forward with the 2x capacity add-on that starts on the renewal date (2028-06-01). To reserve the additional GPU pool for June we typically ask for a 30% partial prepay upfront and invoice the remainder at the renewal effective date.

Summary of asks so we can finalize the invoice and get procurement looped in:
- Can you confirm a PO number we should reference for the 30% prepay?
- Which billing contact/email should we send the pro-forma and final invoice to? (payments@ vs. central finance).
- Do you require the invoice split between the US master account and the EU subsidiary? If so, please share the EU VAT ID and billing entity name.
- Any preferences on net terms? Our standard is Net30; if you need Net45/Net60 let me know and I can request approval from Finance.

I've attached a 30% pro-forma PDF so your procurement team can raise the PO. Once you confirm the PO and billing entity I'll generate an amended renewal invoice and, if needed, a DocuSign amendment to the order.

Attachments: 2028-05-03_Acme_Proforma_30pct.pdf (pro-forma for prepay)

Thanks — looking forward to your PO so we can lock capacity.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for teams
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@acme-dataworks.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: payments@acme-dataworks.com
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 16:48:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on: request for split invoice, prepay and billing contact update

Hi Priya —

Thanks — we're good to proceed with the add-on. A few details from procurement/finance below so you can issue the correct documents: 

- PO for the 30% prepay: PO-ACME-77821 (please reference this on both the pro-forma and the final invoice).
- Please split invoices across:
  * Acme Dataworks Ltd (EU entity) — VAT: IT12345678901 — for 60% of the renewal value (this will be paid by our EU finance team)
  * Acme Dataworks Inc (US) — EIN: 12-3456789 — for 40% (US master account)
- Billing contact for EU split: payments@acme-dataworks.com (cc'd). Please send the pro-forma to this address and the final renewal invoice to payments@acme-dataworks.com and accounting-us@acme-dataworks.com.
- Net terms: we request Net45 for the final invoice. For the 30% prepay we will pay on receipt (immediate).

Also — we do not need a W-8/W-9 for the EU entity, but our EU finance team needs the VAT-exempt note on the invoice and the VAT registration included.

Can you provide an amended pro-forma with the two-line split and the PO reference? If you can include a DocuSign amendment for the capacity add-on (so our legal signs quickly), that would speed things up.

Regards,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement — Acme Dataworks
elena.rossi@acme-dataworks.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + capacity add-on: request for split invoice, prepay and billing contact update

Marcus / Monica — forwarding Acme's reply. Key points:
- PO: PO-ACME-77821 for 30% prepay
- They want a two-line invoice split (EU VAT entity 60% / US 40%), EU needs VAT ID on the invoice and VAT note, final invoice Net45, prepay paid on receipt.

Marcus: can Finance approve Net45 for the final invoice under this renewal? Also confirm whether we can accept a two-entity split on a single renewal (we do this occasionally but want to confirm accounting flow).

Monica: can CS/AM prepare a DocuSign amendment for the capacity add-on (short 1-pager) and confirm the activation date (2028-06-01)? Also once Marcus confirms I'll issue the amended pro-forma and final invoice stub.

I've attached the original pro-forma.

Thanks —
Priya
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal + capacity add-on: request for split invoice, prepay and billing contact update

Priya — approved. Finance is okay with Net45 on the final invoice for this renewal given the enterprise relationship and signed commitment. Notes for execution: 

- Generate two invoice lines on both documents (pro-forma and final): 60% -> "Acme Dataworks Ltd (VAT: IT12345678901)" and 40% -> "Acme Dataworks Inc (EIN: 12-3456789)".
- Reference PO-ACME-77821 on the pro-forma and the prepay invoice.
- Prepay invoice should be marked: "Pro-forma / Deposit — Due on receipt". Final invoice should be marked Net45 and reference the renewal effective date 2028-06-01.
- Accounting routing: send PDF copies to payments@acme-dataworks.com (EU) and accounting-us@acme-dataworks.com (US); billing@redwood-payments should be CC'd for revenue recognition.
- GL codes: 4321-capacity, 2109-deposits (include these on the invoice stub).

Once Priya sends me the amended pro-forma and the final invoice draft, I will countersign the finance approval and route to revenue ops.

—Marcus
